title: Source of Truth
description: Use for domain, contract, state, or generated-artifact work. Covers preserving the intended source of truth and preventing stale generated outputs.

requirements.statement: Use and preserve the intended source of truth for the domain; do not introduce parallel state, duplicate contracts, or frontend-only truth unless explicitly assigned.

Generated/build artifacts must either be generated automatically by the sanctioned workflow or deliberately version-controlled by project policy; do not leave stale generated outputs that can drift from source.
